columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_ID
columns.description: STAKEHOLDER_ID unique identifier. Primary key for HNS_STAKEHOLDERS table.

columns.name: TASK_ID
columns.description: Task Assigned to the stakeholder.

columns.name: EMPLOYEE_ID
columns.description: Employee ID of the stakeholder . The column will be blank if the stakeholder is not an employee.

columns.name: PERSON_ASSIGN_ID
columns.description: Assignment ID of the stakeholder . The column will be blank if the stakeholder is not an employee.

columns.name: TASK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Task Type identifier. Lookup to the Task Type FND lookup.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_NAME
columns.description: The name of the person (Non employee) who is assigned as stakeholder. For Employee name will be blank.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_EMAIL
columns.description: The email ID of the person (Non Employee) who is assigned as stakeholder. For Employee this will be blank.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_TERRITORY_CODE
columns.description: STAKEHOLDER_TERRITORY_CODE column : Stakeholder (Non Employee) Territory code. For Employee this will be blank.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_AREA_CODE
columns.description: STAKEHOLDER_AREA_CODE column : Stakeholder (Non Employee) phone area code. For Employee this will be blank.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_PHONENO
columns.description: The phone number of the person (Non Employee) who is assigned as stakeholder. For Employee phone number will be blank.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_PERSON_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Stakeholder person type. Lookup from FND_LOOKUP EMP/NON EMP lookup.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Stakeholder Category. Lookup for Compliance/Executive/Manager Stakeholder category.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_ORG_NAME
columns.description: SStakeholder Organization Name. In case stakeholder is non-employee, organization stakeholder belongs to.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to check whether is record is deleted.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
